failure.cause: The clarification builder projected each story to one anchor word, so distinct source stories could produce identical clarification prompts. The V103 audit reported unique_prompt_count but failed to enforce equality with probe_count.
failure.impact: V103 PASS is invalid and cannot authorize teacher loading or training. No teacher model was loaded and no neural training occurred.

corrective_action: Version both the clarification prompt builder and verifier, add an adversarial duplicate-prompt test, preregister a successor catalog, and rebuild immutably.
claim_boundary: Negative verifier evidence only; Phase 3 remains uncertified.
